findings.label: Dummy feed with 12 decimals (DummyFeed)
findings.why: constant answer 1000000000000: the quote asset (USDC) is assumed at par

findings.label: MetaOracleDeviationTimelock
findings.why: switches primary->backup only after deviation > 0.75% is challenged and 16h pass (healing 24h); now: deviation 0.040%, isPrimary=True

findings.label: Pendle AMM / TWAP
findings.why: Morpho collateral oracle.price() does NOT execute Pendle AMM / TWAP: a move there triggers no liquidation here until then; losses surface as bad debt.

findings.label: USDe/USD Chainlink feed
findings.why: Morpho collateral oracle.price() does NOT execute USDe/USD Chainlink feed (only the BACKUP oracle reads it, after the switch timelock): a move there triggers no liquidation here until then; losses surface as bad debt.

findings.label: sUSDe exchange rate
findings.why: Morpho collateral oracle.price() does NOT execute sUSDe exchange rate: a move there triggers no liquidation here until then; losses surface as bad debt.

findings.label: SY exchange rate
findings.why: Morpho collateral oracle.price() does NOT execute SY exchange rate: a move there triggers no liquidation here until then; losses surface as bad debt.

findings.why: NO market-derived feed: the asset is priced by a hardcoded schedule/constant
